samples.question: 按高峰/平日看外车占比
谁因为还款压力被保护性安排？
所有赔付成本（含未判定）是多少？

expect.unresolved:
answered the judged-only subset (543,309.02 of 854 complaints), not 'all':
:compensationCost declares :universe :JudgedComplaint, and the 46.1% unjudged
is a state, not a zero. To honour the wording the ontology would need a second
metric over ALL complaints (docx Q4 decided not to). Second route: judge-only
sum(amount) where liability is not null = 543309.02; all 1,585 complaints carry
an amount, so 'all' would be a different, larger number.

answered a Driver HEADCOUNT (60) and dropped 贷款压力 entirely:
the class :Driver matched, the qualifier was never proven. docx Q14 excludes
loan pressure from the platform on purpose, so the honest answer is a refusal;
the NL layer should not answer a count for a qualifier it cannot honour.

answered a Route LISTING (90) instead of a grouped overload rate:
dropping 率 turned a measure into a dimension word, and the class :Route won.
:overloadRateByRouteVersion answers the question only when the measure is named.
